text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Ah... it stirs...! I want to tear loose――
Endure it... I want to devour it――just a little more...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer... please, please!
Keep them safe...!!)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, ...!
—Now! Wake up...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
T　h　a　n　k　s
　f　o　r　t　h　e　m　e　a　l　!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Fufufufufufu...!!
Give it to meeeeee, all of iiiit!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It felt completely surreal.
Still in Love, dancing with frantic ecstasy,
instantly painted over the entire atmosphere—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love crosses the finish line!
Still in Love has won!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Only the second in history! The first Triple Tiara
umamusume since Mejiro Ramonu is born...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The only things echoing through the air were the commentary and my own screams.
Just like at the Oaks—silence enveloped the racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaah!!)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Eek!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a roar unlike anything heard before... an earth-shattering cheer.
—All of it, for Still in Love.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Still in Love—!!
You've achieved the Triple Tiara—!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"That intensity... was a little scary...
but—it got me soooo hyped up...!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Still-chaaaan!
Still—!! Still in Love—!!
Thank you for such an amazing race~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love received cheers, respect, and
applause from countless people.
That sight was truly what she had wished for—
choice_data_list: (...No, I have to make sure I don't cry.)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Still-san, look over here!
Wave to us~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer.
What should I...—"
choice_data_list: Let's wave back with a smile!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer looks so...
so very happy...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(I see.
I was... able to return the favor, wasn't I?)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
—Ah.
That was delicious...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the meal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tears well up in Still in Love's eyes.
However, they weren't tears of joy—for some reason, they looked like tears of sorrow.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...!
I have to... wave to them, don't I?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Everyone...!
Thank you very much...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The meaning of her tears must have been misunderstood.
As she gave a modest wave to the crowd—
she looked so fulfilled, so truly happy.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Why...
Why...?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Alv.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Please tell me!
Was I... in the wrong...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Working hard all by myself... without looking away... even while everyone else was out having fun...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
And yet... why...
Why...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...In the end,
you were completely empty after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"You were strong.
It wasn't because you did anything wrong."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Listen, though.
There's a limit to how strong you can get all by yourself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
All Umamusume grow stronger by supporting one another.
Receiving guidance, absorbing strength... and growing.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Someone inherits the virtues of someone else...
That's how the Twinkle Series has evolved.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
And yet, fighting all alone...
is practically putting yourself at a handicap.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I don't have... anyone.
No one I can rely on...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Then rely on me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I will pour everything I have into you.
All my experience, my knowledge... absolutely everything.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Why...
Why go this far for my sake...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Because out of everyone, you're the most
troublesome, high-maintenance one of all.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What will you do?
...Care to inherit my feelings?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Once all the post-race duties were finished and things had settled down... I suddenly recalled something that had been on my mind.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
“—It is so that I can achieve the Triple Tiara.
Without fail...”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She had a truly demonic intensity back then.
When I asked why she had pushed herself so far—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah... Is that—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...No.
It is fine now.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Because both an innocent heart and the Triple Tiara...
are right here."

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? ...Still in Love!?
U-Um, you were incredible in the Shuka Sho!
Congratulations! I can't wait for your next race!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
Thank you, very much...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer,
why are you smiling like that?"
choice_data_list: I'm just so happy you're getting all this attention.
I'm so happy that you're getting all this attention!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... But, I'm not used to it at all...
People calling out to me, that is...
choice_data_list: It means your brilliance can no longer be hidden.
It means your brilliance can no longer be hidden

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...The next race, huh...
choice_data_list: In my heart, I've already decided.
I've already made up my mind.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Does that mean...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Queen Elizabeth II Cup is another medium-distance race on the Tiara route. However, Senior-class Umamusume will also be competing from here on—
choice_data_list: I have to step up as the representative of my generation!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
As a Triple Tiara Umamusume...
that is.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Let us advance towards the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: You're up against a real powerhouse, so... I was wondering if you're feeling that itch?
